nativeEvidence.scope: Native GenerateContent request/SSE/header-authenticated transport and signed DTO replay passed the exact ddd1d3d hosted60 gate with synthetic peers. The newer working-tree local62 gate verifies common gateway/history, exact callbacks, escaped large results and actual AgentRunner two-file execution with xlang3 SQLite reopen/signed replay, using synthetic provider replies. No full provider-group or individual model acceptance is established.
nativeEvidence.gaps: The 84 pinned Gemini entries are not individually accepted. Default Settings enrollment/catalogue discovery, live inference and actual Gemini IDE/graph acceptance remain pending. Vertex AI/OAuth, media, caching/thinking controls, Interactions and complete per-model behavior remain unimplemented or unverified. The newer exact checkpoint still requires hosted validation.
